### Added
- **Redesigned FlowDown-inspired AI Assistant & SSH Terminal Copilot across macOS and iOS.** Extracted a shared `Foundation/TamioAssistant` package (`TamioAssistant` core + `TamioAssistantUI` components) powered by `Lakr233/MarkdownView` with streaming fade-in, full GFM tables, syntax highlighting, and native **Insert** / **Run in SSH** / **Save as Snippet** actions inside shell code block headers. Consecutive thoughts and tool calls fold into a single **Activity Summary** row that opens a live-updating **Trace** sheet (with an optional **Inline Activity Steps** mode), every tool call asks the model for a human-readable `reason`, tool approvals morph in place inside the composer card with risk grading and scrollable full commands, and messages now support **Rewrite** presets, **View Raw**, **Redo (Edit)** in composer, **Delete w/ After**, and file/image/terminal-snapshot attachments.
- **Automatic AI secret redaction.** Private keys, embedded URL passwords, HTTP authorization headers, well-known API/JWT tokens, and secret environment assignments are now scrubbed locally by default before terminal context or command output is sent to AI models or recorded in agent activity logs.
- **MCP background jobs and per-host access control.** External agents and in-app AI can now run long commands asynchronously with `start_command`, `poll_command` (offset-based incremental output), and `stop_command`. Terminal Copilot panels now support switching between read-only **Ask** mode (with one-click escalation to Agent mode) and full **Agent** mode.
- **Atomi

apps.subtitle: Android 17 running inside an iOS app, without JIT
apps.localizedDescription: Android 17 running inside an iOS app, without JIT.
apps.versionDescription:
Android 17 inside an iPhone or iPad app, with no JIT and no jailbreak. Version 1.25 uses 0.45 GB less memory, starts faster, and keeps every app in the background where 1.24 ended a few: it no longer copies what it can share.

**Nestvane is still for developers only.** The only way to run it is to sign the IPA with a paid Apple Developer Program membership (US$99 a year) and sideload it.

## New in 1.25

- **0.45 GB less memory.** When Android asked for memory to use later, a thread's stack or a region for its allocator, Nestvane wrote zeros through all of it first; and when Android mapped a file, Nestvane often copied the file's bytes where it could have shared the pages it already had. Both are gone: memory is given when it is first used, and the last page of a file, an app's own libraries and the code of every program that is started are shared, each process getting its own copy of a page only when it writes there. On an iPhone 14, 25 seconds after the start, the app uses 2.48 GB where 1.24 used 2.93 GB.
- **A faster start.** Not writing those zeros also takes about 0.3 s off the start: 7.2 s to the Android home screen on an iPhone 14, where 1.24 took 7.5 s.
- **Apps in the background stay.** Seven apps opened in turn for three rounds, with Settings pages in between: no app in the background was ended to make room, in three runs of the test. 1.24 ended two to five each run.
- **Signal opens every time.** It opened about one time in seven: its libraries have to lie close to Android's own code, and that part of the address space was nearly filled by what Android reserves around each thread's stack, which never needed to be there. apps.name: Reloc
apps.subtitle: 虚拟定位与轨迹模拟
apps.localizedDescription: 基于本地回环的 iOS 虚拟定位与轨迹模拟：地图选点、沿真实道路规划轨迹、Apple 快捷指令支持。
apps.versionDescription:
## Reloc v1.0.5

### 更新
- 新增**轨迹模拟**模式：支持地图选点/搜索沿真实道路规划轨迹（多途经点、步行/跑步/骑行/驾车预设、实时调速、拟真波动、往返/循环及收藏路线）。
- 新增 **Apple 快捷指令**支持：提供「开始虚拟定位」（选收藏点 → 启动定位 → 跳转系统定位页清缓存）与「关闭虚拟定位」（停止并跳转系统定位页恢复真实 GPS）两项快捷动作。
- 移除常驻静默音频保活，改用纯原生定位后台模式，降低功耗并避免音频冲突。
- 优化轨迹锁定与防冻结检测，脱锁时自动原地暂停等待重新锁定。
- 最低系统支持降至 **iOS / iPadOS 16.0**（真机实测正常），并修复 iOS 16.0 日志页闪退问题。
- 提示：超过 15 km 的跨城 / 跨国轨迹模拟建议开启飞行模式；远距离定格刷新若未生效，请再次关闭系统「定位服务」并延长等待时间后再重新开启。

---

### What's New
- **Trajectory Simulation**: Plan road-snapped routes with multiple waypoints, Walk/Run/Cycle/Drive presets, live speed control, natural motion, round-trip/loop modes, and saved routes.
- **Apple Shortcuts Support**: Two focused native actions — Start Virtual Location (pick favorite → start GPS → jump to Location Services to clear cache) and Stop Virtual Location (stop & jump to Location Services to restore real GPS).
- **Native Background Mode**: Removed silent audio keep-alive in favor of pure native iOS background location mode for lower power and zero audio conflicts.
- **Improved Trajectory Locking**: Added dead-reckoning freeze detection and auto-hold on lock loss.
- **iOS / iPadOS 16.0 Support**: Verified on iOS/iPadOS 16.0+ devices and fixed an iOS 16.0 logs-view crash.
- **Tips**: Use Airplane Mode for continuous routes >15 km away; for distant fixed locations that don't switch after 7s, turn Location Services off again and wait longer before re-enabling.

apps.name: WQ Files
apps.subtitle: File manager for iOS 26 and 27 (worse_query)
apps.localizedDescription:
File browser, app data manager and cache cleaner for iOS 26 and 27, built on the worse_query sandbox technique. No jailbreak and no kernel exploit.

• Browse every app's data container, app groups, extension and daemon containers
• Plist editor and hex viewer/editor; edits are backed up first
• Select, move across apps, compress and extract ZIPs; import files and whole folders
• Syntax highlighting, SQLite viewer and media player
• Back up, restore and clear app data; AirDrop backups as ZIP
• Cache cleaner
• Shortcuts actions for files, cache cleaning and app backups

iOS 26 and 27 (tested on 26.7.1, 27.0.1 and 27.2.1; on iOS 26, System Data and System Groups are not available). Needs a signer that keeps the App Group entitlement (AltStore, SideStore or Impactor; not Sideloadly).

versions.localizedDescription: Shortcuts actions for files and apps (list, get, save, copy, move, rename, delete, clean caches, back up), a working update check, and many fixes from a full code review: safer restores and imports, fewer hangs, faster lists.
Imports Apps Manager backups (.adbk), says when another app is using a file instead of showing errno 35, and keeps an app's database and its -wal/-shm files together.

Optional App Store icons for other apps (Settings → App Store Icons), fixes apps with one-word bundle ids (like Pinterest) and the empty gap above the Apps list on iOS 27, and keeps the Backups tab working on iOS 27 beta 5.
Custom inspectors (read-only JavaScript, install from a .zip), your own folders and files in the Cache Cleaner, and Japanese.
Fixes LiveContainer setups where every folder was refused, SQLite restore with -wal files, lossless SQLite and plist edits, and backups listed newest first.
Works inside LiveContainer again. Cache Cleaner: Clean is ready after a scan, plus Invert Selection. Wi-Fi uploads stop with sharing.
Recognizes iOS 27.3 beta 2+, where Apple patched worse_query. The access cache repairs itself when another app in the App Group broke it.
Show Folder Sizes, empty folder hints, Colored Cards with a pickable color, themed tiles; WQ Files is back in the Files app; fixes wrong app names on iOS 26.5 and the Crash Logs note.
Apps and Cache Cleaner scans are fast again (more than twice as fast as 0.9.11 and 0.9.12).
Wi-Fi Sharing: browse, download and upload files from any browser on the same Wi-Fi. Themes with importable .wqtheme files, Recent folders and files, progress bars, and a fix for a frozen screen.
Vietnamese translation. Apps and Clean scans keep running across tabs and app restarts, with Pause/Resume and a spinner or clock in the tab bar.
Fixes installed apps missing from Apps, App Data and Extension Data (e.g. on iOS 26.5).
App Groups now show their names on iOS 27.2+. Plain Background option, dark and tinted app icon, files you can't open are dimmed, and a clear notice on iOS 18 and older.
Reset Access Cache is now in Settings → Troubleshooting (both designs). The Log explains why access is blocked and logs a repeated failure only once.

New design: Home with container cards, tabs for Apps, Clean and Backups, Settings behind the gear. The previous design stays available (Settings → New Design). New screens translated into every language.

New: Search Inside Folders, Largest Files, Get Info, Duplicate, Copy to Folder, Favorites, Reopen Last Folder, update notice, Extract and Open for ZIPs, Thai. Safer SQLite save and app restore. Fixed: app backups could come out empty; app names and missing app folders on iOS versions with an unknown app database layout.

New: iOS 27.3 beta, Turkish, flags in the language list, Replace All when importing several files, Rename in Select, restore edited backups. Many safety fixes from a code review (folder delete, SQLite backups, ZIP, hex and plist editors, media).

New: delete folders with everything in them (backed up, restorable), Polish and Russian, filters in App Data, version in the device strip, Reset Access Cache. Fixed: backups with sockets, Share as ZIP of app folders, app names.
New: startup check (stops with what failed instead of empty lists when access breaks), Recently Deleted under Backups. Cache Cleaner progress bar.

### What's New / 更新内容

1. **Dedicated "Import Files" (Multi-Select) & "Import Folder" (Recursive Copy) / 拆分「导入文件（多选）」与「导入文件夹（递归复制）」** *(Thanks to [@leopoldchou](https://github.com/leopoldchou) in [#75](https://github.com/Kianuni/Erosion-CN/issues/75) / 感谢 [@leopoldchou](https://github.com/leopoldchou) 在 [#75](https://github.com/Kianuni/Erosion-CN/issues/75) 提出)*
   - Split file and folder picking into two dedicated menu entries in `FileBrowserView` with automatic container write-access grants and streaming copies without memory spikes.
   - Added a collision prompt when destination names already exist: **Keep Both** (auto-numbered renaming with paired SQLite companion sync) or **Replace** (atomic safe swap).

2. **Multi-Select Mode & Batch Action Bar / 多选模式与底部批量操作栏**
   - Added **Select Items… / 选择文件…** in the top-right action menu with **Select All / Deselect All** controls and a bottom action bar supporting **Batch Share / 批量分享**, **Batch Zip / 批量打包**, and **Batch Delete / 批量删除** (with destructive confirmation and per-item failure reporting).

3. **Destructive Delete Confirmations & Actionable Error Alerts / 删除二次确认弹窗与真实错误提示**
   - Added red destructive confirmation dialogs showing exact target names/counts before deleting any single file, folder, or multi-selected batch.
   - Surfaced exact localized failure reasons across Delete, Unzip, Zip, Rename (now pre-filled with the current filename), Duplicate, and New File/Folder/Plist actions.

4. **ZIP Extraction Confirmation & Dual Mode / ZIP 解压缩确认与双模式解压**
   - Tapping or long-pressing a `.zip` file now asks for confirmation with two choices: **Extract to Current Folder / 解压到当前目录** or **Extract to Subfolder / 解压到同名文件夹** (avoiding name collisions).
   - Runs off the main thread with a live status indicator, pre-validates path traversal and archive symlink escapes, and displays the exact failure reason in an alert when extraction fails.

5. **File Manager Safety & UX Hardening / 文件管理器底层安全护栏与交互增强**
   - **Container Root & Protected Path Guard / 容器根目录与高危文件保护**：Blocks deleting, renaming, or overwriting app/system container roots, container metadata plists, factory backup vault files, `.erosion_adlock` sentinels, and `com.apple.MobileGestalt.plist`.
   - **SQLite Companion Set (`-wal` / `-shm` / `-journal`) Protection / SQLite 伴随文件联动保护**：Uses non-invasive `fcntl(F_GETLK)` and active 10-second WAL write checks to block modifying in-use databases, syncs companions on delete/rename/Keep-Both import, and translates `EAGAIN (35)` / `EBUSY` / `EACCES` / `ENOSPC` into clear bilingual guidance.
   - **Folder Rename, Empty/No-Results States & Optional Async Folder Sizes / 文件夹重命名、空目录占位与可选文件夹体积**：Added guarded folder rename, `ContentUnavailableView` empty/search states, stable path-based item IDs, and an optional **Show Folder Sizes / 显示文件夹大小** toggle in Browser Settings (asynchronous POSIX sizing integrated with Size sorting).

# Added

* JIT. Please keep SideInstaller in the background to keep JIT running
* Sources. Add an AltStore-format source as an https link, an altstore:// or sidestore:// link, or a .json file. Thanks to @TinusTK (#143).

# Fixed

* Sign-in reports a current Mac again. 2.1.1 signed in as a Mac on macOS 10.15.7. Apple sometimes answers that Mac with a text-message code it never sends, or with -22410 or -23782. SideInstaller now signs in as the macOS 26.6 Mac it used up to 2.1.0, spelled \"Mac OS X\", and that Mac gets the code on trusted devices. The first sign-in with a password makes a new anisette identity, so Apple may ask for a code one more time.
* SideStore gets client info Apple lets through. Since 20 November Apple has answered SideStore's default client info with HTTP 503 (SideStore #1745). After installing SideStore, SideInstaller now sets it to the same Mac, spelled \"Mac OS X\". If SideStore then fails with -22410, open its Settings › User Customizations, tick \"Keep header customizations\" and tap Reset adi.pb.
